d: Bihar ki rajdhani patna men bihar vidhanasbha men neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne kendr sarkar, kendriy janch ejensiyon aur bihar ki endie sarkar par tikha hamla bola hai. midiya se batchit karte hue tejasvi yadav ne eedi, sibiaaee aur inkam taiks ki karyapranali par saval uthae aur sath hi bihar sarkar ke mantri ashok chaudhri ke mamle men rajabhvan ki aapatti ka havala dete hue unhen mantri pad se hatane tatha unki vidhan parishad (MLC) sadasyata radd karne ki mang ki.
